item.title: 'I love you' on clothes & a chilling note: What preceded Gurgaon techie couple's deaths
item.description: An IT professional, Mohammad Aslam, and his wife, Farhana, were discovered dead in their Gurgaon apartment. Aslam sent an alarming email to his employer before the incident, indicating a distressing situation. Police suspect that Aslam may have killed his wife before taking his own life. Relatives claim that Aslam had been struggling with depression for about 18 months prior to the tragedy.
item.dc:creator: SAMAD HOQUE

item.title: 'How it feels': Dipke shares cheeky SRK post after walking out of jail
item.description: Abhijeet Dipke was granted bail on certain conditions on Saturday, less than 24 hours after Delhi Police took him into preventive custody over his planned 'Tiranga Yatra' in Connaught Place (CP). Dipke was detained shortly after leaving the residence of NCP-SCP spokesperson Anish Gawande, where he had been staying, to attend the planned flag march in Connaught Place.
item.dc:creator: RAJEEV SINGH

item.title: TDP, YSRCP clash during Andhra poll nominations; police fire 6 rounds in Jagan’s turf
item.description: Violent confrontations broke out between TDP and YSRCP activists in Kadapa during the nominations filing phase. Police had to intervene in Pulivendula when YSRCP supporters tried to rush the nominations centre. Clashes also occurred in places like Mydukur and Rayachoti, resulting in injuries among party workers. Several YSRCP leaders were placed under house arrest due to these escalating tensions.
item.dc:creator: SANDEEP RAGHAVAN

item.title: US Congressman claims H-1B visa holders from India, China replacing Americans
item.dc:creator: AASHISH VASHISTHA

item.title: 'An evening in Paris': Opposition questions 'nature' of Punjab CM Mann's France visit
item.description: Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann's trip to Paris has triggered criticism from opposition leaders and parties. Concerns have been raised regarding drug abuse, law and order, and recent violent incidents in the state. Critics question the appropriateness of Mann's foreign visit, especially as he celebrated his birthday during a crisis. Allegations suggest that he attended a police meeting under the influence of alcohol, which raises further concerns.
item.dc:creator: TRISHA MAHAJAN

item.title: USCIS: Anyone who ‘guarantees’ a faster visa or Green Card is scamming you
item.description: USCIS warns immigrants and visa applicants about fraudulent schemes that promise quicker visa approvals in exchange for monetary fees. These scams frequently involve false claims of having special ties to government officials. USCIS insists that no one can hasten the immigration process through personal connections. Individuals should file applications independently and trust assistance only from recognized professionals. Recognizing fraudulent emails and suspicious offers is essential to protect against these scams.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: New York court rejects daughter’s claimed life estate in Queens property
item.description: A property transfer made by a Queens mother in 1987 led to a legal dispute nearly four decades later. Mary Mangiaracina had tried to secure lifetime rights to the Ridgewood property for herself and her daughter. However, after the property was sold to new owners, her daughter challenged the sale-related ownership claims in court. In April 2026, a New York appeals court ruled that the daughter had never legally received those lifetime rights.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: Watch: Masked French protesters briefly storm Marseille city hall
item.description: Protesters briefly occupied the lobby of Marseille city hall to voice their discontent over rising fuel costs. They shouted revolutionary slogans while some vandalized property within the building. Law enforcement later dispersed the crowd, which resulted in several violent clashes. Tens of thousands are expected to demonstrate nationwide against the increasing cost of living and perceived inequality.
item.dc:creator: PRANJAL PANDEY

item.title: Hope for history: WI skipper eyes Salt, Babar's world records in 5th T20I vs India
item.description: Hope scored an unbeaten century in the fourth T20I on Wednesday (October 14) and has made 261 runs across the four matches so far.
item.dc:creator: SHUBHANSHU DWIVEDI

item.title: Stalin challenges Rahul's SIR credit claim with Bihar, Soren reminder
item.description: MK Stalin endorsed protests against the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls and criticized Congress for its inconsistent positions. During a DMK Parliamentary Party meeting, four resolutions were adopted, including the removal of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. The DMK emphasized its early opposition to the SIR process and questioned Congress's credibility on the issue. Resolutions included support for student protests and criticism of local party leaders’ silence.
item.dc:creator: PALLAVI

item.title: Brad Paisley and wife help open free Nashville grocery store with $1m gift
item.description: Brad Paisley and Kimberly Williams-Paisley have expanded their philanthropic efforts by launching a second location of The Store, a nonprofit grocery aimed at combating food insecurity in Nashville. Following their first store's success in 2020, which garnered over 3,100 dedicated volunteers, the couple has invested $1 million into this new initiative to ensure families receive dignified access to food choices and additional resources.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: Australian couple, 85 and 82, restore 970 hectares after 20 years of work
item.description: In their eighties, Ken and Jill Hooper have become dedicated stewards of bushland in Australia, showcasing an inspiring commitment to conservation post-retirement. Over the last twenty years, after acquiring properties in Victoria and New South Wales, they focus on enhancing biodiversity and curbing invasive species to safeguard native wildlife. Their work reflects a significant trend of older Australians contributing to community conservation, aiming to foster a legacy for future generations.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: Meta AI CEO sends long thanks note to his team; says: I am so grateful for every one
item.description: Alexandr Wang expressed his gratitude to the dedicated researchers and engineers at Meta Superintelligence Labs for rolling out their innovative AI models. He pointed out that the objective was to develop a cutting-edge AI model within just a year. The team worked tirelessly on intricate tasks without rigid deadlines, fostering a spirit of collaboration and intellectual prowess.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: Laguna Beach mansion listed for $112m sells for $82.57m
item.description: A contemporary mansion in Laguna Beach has been sold for $82.6 million, which is significantly below the asking price. The property was purchased by David Wilson in 2001 for $16 million and has since been upgraded. With eight bedrooms and numerous luxurious amenities, the mansion spans over 14,400 square feet. This sale ranks as the second-priciest residential deal in Orange County's history.
item.dc:creator: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK

item.title: 'Drishyam 3' box office Day 16 : Ajay Devgn starrer set to cross Rs 350 crore net
item.description: Ajay Devgn's much-anticipated film, 'Drishyam 3: The Conclusion,' has seen remarkable success at the box office, amassing over Rs 338.41 crore in India since its release. The film, directed by Abhishek Pathak and featuring a stellar cast including Ajay Devgn and Tabu, has garnered admiration from audiences and critics alike. Mohanlal has also publicly lauded the Hindi adaptation, further enhancing its appeal across theaters nationwide.
item.dc:creator: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK

item.title: Jon Jones visited Henry Cejudo six times after praising his fight breakdowns
item.description: Henry Cejudo revealed that Jon Jones contacted him after viewing his fight breakdowns on YouTube. Cejudo noted that Jones was impressed by his analysis and appreciated his insights. Their collaboration involved several training sessions to refine Jones' skills ahead of his heavyweight debut. Cejudo maintained that he did not see himself as Jones' coach during their work together. The relationship highlights mutual respect between two accomplished athletes in combat sports.
item.dc:creator: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK

item.title: Rio Ferdinand faces fan backlash after fat-shaming row with Man United creator
item.description: Rio Ferdinand engaged in a controversial social media exchange with influencer Saeed TV concerning Manchester United's leadership. After criticism over his silence on the club's ownership, Ferdinand replied with a personal jab about Saeed's weight. The incident sparked varied reactions from fans, some supporting Ferdinand while others found his comment inappropriate. Saeed later criticized Ferdinand's behavior, suggesting it was unbecoming of a public figure.
item.dc:creator: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK

item.title: Malayalam filmmaker Belraj Kalarickal dies at 27
item.description: Belraj Kalarickal, a Malayalam filmmaker, recently died at the age of 27, possibly from a heart attack. He was discovered in a hotel room in Kochi, to the shock of his colleagues. Belraj had recently made his directorial debut with the web series 'Kappi Squad' just days before his death. He was a founding member of First Print Studios, contributing significantly to its projects.
item.dc:creator: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK

item.title: Ukraine’s defences against Russia hit by Starlink limits, Kyiv in talks with US
item.dc:creator: SUBHADRA SRIVASTAVA

item.title: Why Trump's plan to unleash 'Mother Of All Bombs' may fall flat in Iran
item.description: Military discussions are considering the use of the MOAB against Iran's nuclear facilities and military targets. However, the effectiveness of the MOAB is limited against deeply buried sites protected by reinforced concrete. Analysts highlight that the GBU-57 penetrator is better suited for such underground facilities, which require specialized weapons for effective targeting. While the MOAB has a strong psychological impact, its military utility against hardened targets is questionable.
item.dc:creator: DHRUV YADAV

item.title: ‘JD wanted to chat real quick’: How Trump’s press secy was fired mid-interview
item.description: Katie Zacharia's brief tenure as White House press secretary ended abruptly after just five days due to a rocky start marked by an underwhelming briefing and questions regarding her qualifications. Despite Donald Trump's warning to reconsider the role, she was determined to fulfill her duties to the president and the nation. Her departure leaves the press office in limbo, especially with midterm elections approaching.
item.dc:creator: AASHISH VASHISTHA

item.title: Australian cricketer slams 14-ball fifty, misses Sooryavanshi's world record
item.description: Jake Fraser-McGurk made history by scoring the fastest half-century in One-Day Cup history. His incredible innings of 122 runs off just 63 balls, supported by Nathan McSweeney's 106, propelled South Australia to a formidable total of 397/7 against Queensland. With a striking display featuring ten fours and nine sixes, Fraser-McGurk's talent shone brightly at the Karen Rolton Oval.
item.dc:creator: NITESH DUBEY

item.title: Russia rains over 300 drones, missiles on Ukraine, hits 15-plus energy facilities
item.dc:creator: VIJAYA SRIVASTAVA

item.title: HDFC deputy MD Kaizad Bharucha announces exit ahead of Anup Bagchi's takeover as CEO
item.description: HDFC Bank's Deputy Managing Director, Kaizad Bharucha, has announced his resignation, effective December 31. This move precedes Anup Bagchi's appointment as the new Managing Director and CEO. In the latest reports, HDFC Bank has demonstrated remarkable profitability shifts this July to September, reflecting improved asset quality and a surge in net profit. Bharucha's resignation awaits approval from the Reserve Bank of India, as it has been accepted by the board.
item.dc:creator: TRISHA MAHAJAN

item.title: Iran unable to fund 'proxy militia'; lost $25b in oil exports to naval blockade: US
item.description: The United States has asserted that Iran faces significant financial challenges due to a naval blockade. This blockade has reportedly restricted Iran's import and export capabilities, particularly affecting oil. Additionally, the US claims that Iran has suffered substantial losses, estimated at $25 billion, due to this blockade. Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps recently reported an incident involving a supertanker in the Strait of Hormuz.
item.dc:creator: PRANJAL PANDEY

item.title: Congress alleges RSS-BJP agenda behind Census 2027 changes
item.description: The Congress party on Saturday expressed alarm over the BJP-led government's decision to broaden the pool of eligible enumerators for Census 2027, prompting the inclusion of teachers from various educational institutions as census officers. Congress general secretary Jairam Ramesh has argued that this change jeopardizes the integrity of the census.
item.dc:creator: SUBHADRA SRIVASTAVA

item.title: Pope Leo XIV to be discharged from hospital after successful lung cancer surgery today
item.description: Pope Leo XIV is set to leave the hospital after a successful lung cancer surgery, demonstrating commendable recovery progress. He engaged positively with his senior aides, expressing heartfelt gratitude towards the medical team for their dedicated care. As doctors await crucial test results to plan further treatment, the pontiff's upcoming trip to Latin America from November 6 to 17 highlights his determination to fulfill his commitments.
item.dc:creator: TRISHA MAHAJAN

item.title: You earn, save and invest. But are you financially literate? 10 questions to ask
item.description: Financial literacy encompasses understanding one's income, expenses, and the risks associated with investments. Differentiating between saving and investing is crucial for effective financial planning. Individuals must be vigilant against financial fraud and misleading guidance in their investment choices. A well-structured financial plan aids in aligning savings and investments with personal objectives. Familiarity with financial concepts empowers individuals to make thoughtful decisions and manage their finances responsibly.
item.dc:creator: TRISHA MAHAJAN

item.title: CJI flags ‘external forces’ that threatened to disrupt NLSIU convocation
item.description: At the NLSIU convocation ceremony in Bengaluru, Chief Justice Surya Kant acknowledged external challenges that threatened the event, inspiring graduates to champion legal principles with unwavering integrity. Deputy chief minister DK Shivakumar reinforced the notion of law as a civic duty, sharing plans to bolster the state's legal system. Students were proudly awarded their degrees, marking the start of their professional journeys in the legal field.
item.dc:creator: VIJAYA SRIVASTAVA

item.title: Imran Khan facing Nawaz, Benazir-style exile deal? Pak oppn leader's big claim
item.description: Pakistan opposition Mahmood Khan Achakzai has raised concerns that Imran Khan might be coerced into negotiating an exile agreement, drawing parallels to the previous exiles of Nawaz Sharif and Benazir Bhutto. He noted that opposition parties are joining forces to tackle pressing political issues. Additionally, Achakzai criticized the current limitations on prisoner meetings and advocated for stronger parliamentary actions. Moreover, opposition leaders have legally contested the governor's rule imposed in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
item.dc:creator: AYUSH PANDEY

item.title: ‘Truly historic’: Putin’s envoy hails Trump’s move to suspend Russia sanctions
item.dc:creator: SUBHADRA SRIVASTAVA

item.title: Iran helping Houthis: How Tehran is hitting Saudi Arabia without fighting directly
item.description: Iran's backing of Yemen's Houthi rebels has intensified, providing crucial intelligence and military guidance against Saudi Arabia. This partnership has evolved into a robust military collaboration involving advanced weaponry training, drone development, and missile production. Analysts emphasize that this Iranian support has significantly empowered the Houthis in their ongoing conflict. The increasing influence of Tehran raises substantial security concerns in the region, prompting regional leaders to reevaluate their strategies.
item.dc:creator: ARYAN SINGH

item.title: SAD chief Badal holds CM Mann responsible for Punjab anti-drug activist’s murder
item.description: Sukhbir Singh Badal has held Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann accountable for the breakdown of law and order following the tragic murder of anti-drug activist Parwinder Singh, also known as Jhota. The incident occurred during an altercation over drug sales at a pharmacy. CM Mann expressed his regret over the incident and assured citizens of a comprehensive investigation.
item.dc:creator: ARYAN SINGH

item.title: Man strangles 40-yr-old neighbour after spat over parking, loud music
item.description: In a disturbing turn of events, a pharmacist allegedly lured his neighbor, an auto driver, to a party with malicious intent. After drugging him following conflicts over parking and music volume, he committed murder by strangulation. The victim, Pawan Sharma, was reported missing by his family, prompting an investigation that led to the arrest of Lalit Kumar Sharma, alongside the recovery of the vehicle used in the crime.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: India’s Zorawar light tank faces protection and performance trade-off
item.description: India's Zorawar light tank program is facing a critical design challenge in upgrading protection without sacrificing mobility. The Indian Army requires stronger armour to resist more powerful ammunition and threats. Development is ongoing by the Defence Research and Development Organisation and Larsen & Toubro, with an expected service entry around 2028-2029. A phased approach might help balance initial production with future upgrades for protection.
item.dc:creator: DHRUV YADAV
